plan: Price equals my value (25). Winning now yields zero profit; the next increment (25.5) would give negative profit. Since I can't see others' actions and risk overpaying, I should drop to avoid potential negative payoff.

Current value $26; current price $26.5 (next $27). If I win, profit = 26 - price < 0, so winning yields a loss. Dropping guarantees zero profit. Staying could only produce negative payoff. Therefore I should drop now.
